<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth2UserToken ( Scopes: tweet.read users.read ), UserToken, BearerToken
</aside>

## Get Users by Usernames

<a id="opIdgetUsersByUsernames"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://api.x.com/2/users/by?usernames=string' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /2/users/by`

<h3 id="get-users-by-usernames-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|usernames|query|[string]|true|none|
|user.fields|query|[string]|false|A comma separated list of User fields to display.|

<h3 id="get-users-me-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The request has succeeded.|[GetUsersMeResponse](#schemagetusersmeresponse)|
|default|Default|The request has failed.|[Error](#schemaerror)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth2UserToken ( Scopes: tweet.read users.read ), UserToken
</aside>

## Get the authenticated user's followers

<a id="opIdgetUsersMeFollowers"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.x.com/2/users/me/followers \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /2/users/me/followers`

Same results as `GET /2/users/{id}/followers` with the authenticated user's ID.

<h3 id="get-the-authenticated-users-followers-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|max_results|query|integer(int32)|false|none|
|pagination_token|query|string|false|A base32hex-encoded pagination token.|
|user.fields|query|[string]|false|A comma separated list of User fields to display.|
|expansions|query|[string]|false|A comma separated list of fields to expand.|
|post.fields|query|[string]|false|A comma separated list of Post fields to display.|

<h3 id="get-the-authenticated-users-followers-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The request has succeeded.|[GetUsersMeFollowersResponse](#schemagetusersmefollowersresponse)|
|default|Default|The request has failed.|[Error](#schemaerror)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth2UserToken ( Scopes: follows.read tweet.read users.read ), UserToken
</aside>

## Get the users the authenticated user follows

<a id="opIdgetUsersMeFollowing"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.x.com/2/users/me/following \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /2/users/me/following`

Same results as `GET /2/users/{id}/following` with the authenticated user's ID.

<h3 id="get-the-users-the-authenticated-user-follows-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|max_results|query|integer(int32)|false|none|
|pagination_token|query|string|false|A base32hex-encoded pagination token.|
|user.fields|query|[string]|false|A comma separated list of User fields to display.|
|expansions|query|[string]|false|A comma separated list of fields to expand.|
|post.fields|query|[string]|false|A comma separated list of Post fields to display.|

```bash
curl https://api.x.com/2/users/2244994945/affiliates \
```

## Create Bookmark

<a id="opIdcreateUsersBookmark"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.x.com/2/users/2244994945/bookmarks \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "folder_id": "string",
    "tweet_id": "string",
    "tweet_ids": [
      "string"
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /2/users/{id}/bookmarks`

Adds one or more Posts to the authenticated user's Bookmarks. Supply `tweet_id` for a single Post, or `tweet_ids` (at most 25) to bookmark several in one request. Optional `folder_id` applies to every Post in the request. Billing and rate limits still apply per HTTP request.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "folder_id": "string",
  "tweet_id": "string",
  "tweet_ids": [
    "string"
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="create-bookmark-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|[UserId](#schemauserid)|true|none|
|body|body|[CreateUsersBookmarkRequest](#schemacreateusersbookmarkrequest)|true|none|
|» folder_id|body|string|false|Optional ID of the Bookmark folder to add the Post(s) to. When omitted, Posts are added to the user's top-level Bookmarks only. A bulk request uses this one folder for every ID.|
|» tweet_id|body|string|false|The ID of the Post to add to the user's Bookmarks. Mutually exclusive with `tweet_ids`.|
|» tweet_ids|body|[string]|false|Post IDs to add to the user's Bookmarks. At most 25. Mutually exclusive with `tweet_id`.|
|» *anyOf*|body|object|false|none|
|» *anyOf*|body|object|false|none|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "data": {
    "bookmarked": true
  }
}
```

> default Response

```json
{
  "code": 0,
  "message": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="create-bookmark-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The request has succeeded.|[CreateUsersBookmarkResponse](#schemacreateusersbookmarkresponse)|
|default|Default|The request has failed.|[Error](#schemaerror)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth2UserToken ( Scopes: users.read tweet.read bookmark.write )
</aside>

## Get Users Following

<a id="opIdgetUsersFollowing"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.x.com/2/users/2244994945/following \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /2/users/{id}/following`

## Get Users Mentions

<a id="opIdgetUsersMentions"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.x.com/2/users/2244994945/mentions \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /2/users/{id}/mentions`

When both are provided, `start_time` must be earlier than `end_time`. When both are provided, `since_id` must be less than `until_id`.

<h3 id="get-users-mentions-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|[UserId](#schemauserid)|true|none|
|max_results|query|integer(int32)|false|none|
|pagination_token|query|string|false|A base32hex-encoded pagination token.|
|start_time|query|string(date-time)|false|Must be on or after 2010-11-06.|
|end_time|query|string(date-time)|false|Must be on or after 2010-11-06.|
|since_id|query|string|false|none|
|until_id|query|string|false|none|
|post.fields|query|[string]|false|A comma separated list of Post fields to display.|
|expansions|query|[string]|false|A comma separated list of fields to expand.|
|user.fields|query|[string]|false|A comma separated list of User fields to display.|
|media.fields|query|[string]|false|A comma separated list of Media fields to display.|
|poll.fields|query|[string]|false|A comma separated list of Poll fields to display.|
|place.fields|query|[string]|false|A comma separated list of Place fields to display.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|post.fields|article|
|post.fields|article_title|
|post.fields|attachments|
|post.fields|card_uri|

`DELETE /2/users/{id}/retweets/{source_tweet_id}`

Causes the authenticated user to unrepost a specific Post by its ID.

<a href="https://developer.twitter.com/en/docs/twitter-api/tweets/retweets/api-reference/delete-users-id-retweets-tweet_id">External documentation</a>

|source_tweet_id|path|string|true|none|

## Unblock User

<a id="opIdusersIdUnblock"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.x.com/2/users/2244994945/blocking/2244994945 \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /2/users/{source_user_id}/blocking/{target_user_id}`

Causes the source User to unblock the target User.

<a href="https://developer.twitter.com/en/docs/twitter-api/users/blocks/api-reference/delete-users-user_id-blocking">External documentation</a>

|source_user_id|path|[UserId](#schemauserid)|true|none|
|target_user_id|path|[UserId](#schemauserid)|true|none|

<h1 id="x-api-v2-webhooks">Webhooks</h1>

Endpoints relating to retrieving, managing webhooks and webhook configs

<a href="https://docs.x.com/x-api/enterprise-gnip-2.0/fundamentals/account-activity">Find out more</a>

## Get stream links

<a id="opIdgetWebhooksStreamLinks"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.x.com/2/webhooks/replay \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \

    "from_date": "string",
```

`POST /2/webhooks/replay`

Creates a replay job to retrieve events from up to the past 24 hours for all events delivered or attempted to be delivered to the webhook.

<a href="https://docs.x.com/x-api/webhooks/introduction">External documentation</a>

> Body parameter

```json

  "from_date": "string",
  "to_date": "string",
  "webhook_id": "string"
}
```

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[CreateWebhookReplayJobRequest](#schemacreatewebhookreplayjobrequest)|true|none|
|» from_date|body|string|true|The oldest (inclusive) UTC timestamp from which events are replayed, in yyyymmddhhmm format.|
|» to_date|body|string|true|The newest (inclusive) UTC timestamp up to which events are replayed, in yyyymmddhhmm format.|

```json
{
```
```json
  "available_for_replay": true,
  "broadcast_id": "string",
```
```json
  "chat_option": "string",
  "description": "string",
  "locale": "string",
  "manual_publish": true,
```
```json
  "recurring_schedule_id": "string",
  "scheduled_broadcast_id": "string",
  "scheduled_end_ms": "string",
  "scheduled_start_ms": "string",
  "source_id": "string",
  "state": "string",
  "telecast_id": "string",
  "thumbnail_media_id": "string",
  "title": "string"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|available_for_replay|boolean|false|none|Whether replay is enabled.|
|broadcast_id|string|false|none|Alphanumeric broadcast id (path `:id` for get/update/delete/live).|
|chat_option|string|false|none|Who can chat (numeric string): `0` default, `1` chat off, `2` everyone, `3` verified accounts, `4` accounts the host follows, `5` the host's subscribers, `6` accounts followed by an account the host follows.|
|description|string|false|none|Optional description.|
|locale|string|false|none|Optional locale.|
|manual_publish|boolean|false|none|When true, coordinator will not auto-publish; call POST .../live when ready.|
|recurring_schedule_id|string|false|none|Deprecated: always null for new schedules.|
|scheduled_broadcast_id|string|false|none|Numeric scheduler id. Required in the update request body.|
|scheduled_end_ms|string|false|none|Scheduled end, milliseconds since Unix epoch (decimal string).|
|scheduled_start_ms|string|false|none|Scheduled start, milliseconds since Unix epoch (decimal string).|
|source_id|string|false|none|Bound ingest / source id (`rtmp_stream_key`).|
|state|string|false|none|Scheduler state: `Created` or `Scheduled` before start, then `Running`, `Ended`, or `Error`.|
|telecast_id|string|false|none|Deprecated: always null for new schedules.|
|thumbnail_media_id|string|false|none|Optional pre-live slate media id.|
|title|string|false|none|Broadcast title / status text.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|available_for_replay|boolean|false|none|Whether replay is enabled.|
|broadcast_id|string|false|none|Alphanumeric broadcast id (path `:id` for get/update/delete/live).|
|chat_option|string|false|none|Who can chat (numeric string): `0` default, `1` chat off, `2` everyone, `3` verified accounts, `4` accounts the host follows, `5` the host's subscribers, `6` accounts followed by an account the host follows.|
|description|string|false|none|Optional description.|
|locale|string|false|none|Optional locale.|
|manual_publish|boolean|false|none|When true, coordinator will not auto-publish; call POST .../live when ready.|
|recurring_schedule_id|string|false|none|Deprecated: always null for new schedules.|
|scheduled_broadcast_id|string|false|none|Numeric scheduler id. Required in the update request body.|
|scheduled_end_ms|string|false|none|Scheduled end, milliseconds since Unix epoch (decimal string).|
|scheduled_start_ms|string|false|none|Scheduled start, milliseconds since Unix epoch (decimal string).|
|source_id|string|false|none|Bound ingest / source id (`rtmp_stream_key`).|
|state|string|false|none|Scheduler state: `Created` or `Scheduled` before start, then `Running`, `Ended`, or `Error`.|
|telecast_id|string|false|none|Deprecated: always null for new schedules.|
|thumbnail_media_id|string|false|none|Optional pre-live slate media id.|
|title|string|false|none|Broadcast title / status text.|

A Tweet or error that can be returned by the streaming Tweet API. The values returned with a successful streamed Tweet includes the user provided rules that the Tweet matched.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|data|[Post](#schemapost)|false|none|none|
|errors|[[Problem](#schemaproblem)]|false|none|none|
|includes|[Expansions](#schemaexpansions)|false|none|none|
|matching_rules|[object]|false|none|The list of rules which matched the Tweet|

```json
{
  "allow_dms_from": "all",

  "av_settings": {
    "av_call_permissions": {
      "accept_calls_from_addressbook": true,
      "accept_calls_from_everyone": true,
      "accept_calls_from_following": true,
      "accept_calls_from_verified": true
    },
    "has_av_calls_enabled": true,
    "has_enhanced_call_privacy_enabled": true
  },
  "dm_quality_filter": "enabled",
  "dm_receipt_settings": "all_enabled"
}
```

At least one of `allow_dms_from`, `always_allow_dms_from_subscribers`, `dm_quality_filter`, `dm_receipt_settings`, `av_settings` is required.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|allow_dms_from|string|false|none|Who can send the user messages: `all` (anyone), `verified` (verified accounts only), or `following` (accounts the user follows).|
|always_allow_dms_from_subscribers|boolean|false|none|Whether the user's subscribers can always message them regardless of allow_dms_from.|
|av_settings|[UpdateChatSettingsAvSettings](#schemaupdatechatsettingsavsettings)|false|none|Audio and video call settings.|
|dm_quality_filter|string|false|none|Low-quality message request filter: `enabled` (low-quality requests go to a separate folder) or `disabled` (all requests stay in the main inbox).|
|dm_receipt_settings|string|false|none|Read receipts: `all_enabled` (send and receive read receipts) or `all_disabled` (neither).|
|*anyOf*|object|false|none|none|
|*anyOf*|object|false|none|none|
|*anyOf*|object|false|none|none|
|*anyOf*|object|false|none|none|
|*anyOf*|object|false|none|none|

|allow_dms_from|verified|
|allow_dms_from|following|

|dm_receipt_settings|all_enabled|
|dm_receipt_settings|all_disabled|
